request: response and units; stock/flow/rate/index type and aggregation
calendar, time zone and unique row identity
model structure, priors, full R random state and bsts seed semantics
iteration/resource limits and compatible package/build identities
response: posterior draws or hash-bound draw artifact
point and cumulative summaries with predictive/posterior labels
failure_rules: Do not treat class CausalImpact alone as successful fit: NULL fitted model and NA inferences remain unavailable.
Missing controls and inadmissible boundaries are distinguishable input failures.
Do not clip periods, fill omitted calendar dates or change aggregation without an explicit recorded transformation.
Do not replace an undefined ratio with zero or a bounded percentage.
Unjustified causal restrictions are a scientific scope failure, not automatically a numerical error.

future_behavioral_oracle.kind: same-environment matched direct R versus adapter execution
fixtures: supplied model retaining observed post outcomes
future_behavioral_oracle.source_tests: Inspected upstream tests provide candidate cases, not executed evidence.

independent_checks.anchor: Authored law and reporting constructions, no native engine run

future_behavioral_oracle.statistical_study: Separate prospective protocol after profile: declared observation law, contamination/break stress cases, matched baselines, fixed seeds/budget/stopping rule; no post-hoc tuning.
